svg.title: When Renovate leaves a branch alone
svg.desc: Renovate compares the author and the committer of every commit on its branch with its own address and its rule gitIgnoredAuthors. A commit of Renovate lets it go on rebasing, and so does one of the fix bot, the branch bot or another bot, which commit as the release app: where Renovate runs as the release app, that is its own address, and for the Mend Renovate app the rules of the blueprint name it. A commit of anyone else, also a merge that a person starts with Update branch, counts as an edit, and Renovate leaves the branch alone until a person ticks the box in the pull request, which builds the branch anew without that commit.
